title: Colocation selection becomes trading strategy for firms
summary: Colocation selection becomes active trading strategy for data center firms
detailed: Trading firms must consider proximity, latency consistency, and connectivity when choosing colocation, moving beyond traditional data center criteria.
These factors are crucial for execution quality in financial markets.
